title: RPGCoins DataPack
description: Created this for the RPG Coins Created by Riser876
body:
Datapack for [RPG Coins](https://modrinth.com/datapack/rpgcoins) created by [Riser876](https://modrinth.com/user/Riser876).
This datapack adds custom crafting recipes and functionality for coin items used alongside the RPG Coins mod. Install by placing the ZIP file into your world/datapacks folder and leave it zipped.

[Github Source](https://github.com/Hydra-Labs-LLC/RPGCoins-DataPack)
